story: Explore the fascinating world of the Jungle Owlet (Glaucidium radiatum). Classified under the Strigidae family, this bird predominantly inhabits Scrub forest; deciduous/moist deciduous forests; densely wooded lowlands and foothills. The current IUCN classification of Least Concern (LC) underscores the importance of safeguarding its natural range. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the Jungle Owlet is a testament to the intricate web of life. By studying species like the Jungle Owlet, we gain valuable insights into broader ecological trends.
